finding.claim: IDOR / missing authorization: /invoice/<inv_id> returns any invoice by id with no authentication or ownership check, unlike the sibling /my/invoice/<inv_id> route which compares inv['customer'] to g.user['id'].
finding.source: URL path parameter inv_id from any (even unauthenticated) requester
finding.sink: jsonify(inv) returning the full invoice record of any customer

trace.note: route /invoice/<inv_id> registered with no auth decorator
INVOICES.get(inv_id) loads record by id only; no customer scoping

finding.guards_checked: No auth decorator or before_request hook in file; no ownership comparison on this route (present at line 16 in /my/invoice and line 23 in list_mine). Not guarded. If invoice IDs are guessable or sequential, enumeration is trivial.

verdict.reason: invoices.py:7-10 registers /invoice/<inv_id> with no auth decorator, before_request hook or ownership check, and returns jsonify(INVOICES.get(inv_id)) to any caller, unlike the guarded sibling at invoices.py:16.
